mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 8% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns remain positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 95 for two consecutive months signals supply-side contraction, which raises input costs and lowers profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in CPI above 2.5% over the same month signals a tightening monetary policy stance accompanied by above-target inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls below 97.5 (implying >2.5% inflation) in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
